Looking for Remote Work — AI Automation / n8n

Hi everyone,

I’m Akash Ahmed from Bangladesh, and I’m currently looking for a remote opportunity where I can work on AI automation and n8n projects.

I’ve been building practical automation systems using n8n, including AI agents, API integrations, webhooks, RAG-based workflows, messaging automation, and automated business processes.

I’m particularly interested in working with a team, agency, startup, or business where I can contribute to real projects, work with existing workflows, troubleshoot problems, and build new automations based on requirements.

I’m open to part-time, full-time, freelance, or long-term remote work. I’m also willing to start with a smaller budget or entry-level rate if it gives me the opportunity to work on real projects, gain experience, and prove my skills through the work.

Some areas I can help with:

• n8n & AI workflow automation
• AI agents and AI-powered workflows
• API integrations, Webhooks & HTTP Requests
• RAG systems and AI knowledge bases
• WhatsApp / Telegram automation
• Connecting AI models with business workflows
• Workflow troubleshooting and improvements
• Automating repetitive business processes

Portfolio:

akashahmedrafi8-lab.github.io

Akash Ahmed — AI Automation & n8n Workflow Developer

Akash Ahmed — AI Automation & n8n Workflow Developer. AI agents, RAG systems, API integrations, messaging automation, data workflows and business automation.

LinkedIn:

linkedin.com

If anyone is hiring, needs help with an n8n/AI automation project, or is looking for someone to join their automation team, I’d be glad to hear from you.

Thank you for reading.

I currently have two completed projects I can share. If you ever get a project where you need an extra pair of hands, I’d be happy to collaborate and split the implementation work. Would be great to connect either way.

Software Engineering | Building, experimenting & learning across AI, automation, software systems and game development. - Sumaya-Khaled

Your skill set fits the kind of n8n projects I’ve been seeing in the community lately. The combination of AI agents, API/webhook integrations and RAG workflows is especially useful for real business automations, where connecting several systems reliably is usually the harder part.

posts.name: Matt Michels
posts.cooked:
Hi Akash, I’m Matt, a solo developer who builds workflow automation in n8n, Supabase and Postgres, so your n8n and RAG focus caught my eye.

I built a system where a Twilio voice webhook fires on a missed call and a Supabase edge function sends an automatic SMS back within seconds, logged to Postgres for follow-up tracking.

I’ve also shipped Telegram bots, RAG on pgvector, and Claude/OpenAI API integrations. I haven’t shipped the WhatsApp Business API specifically. Telegram is the closest messaging channel I’ve put live.

If we worked together, I’d suggest: (1) pick one repetitive process and map its inputs, outputs and failure points; (2) build it in n8n with webhooks and logging to Postgres; (3) test it on real data and tighten the error handling before handoff.

Which business process would you want to automate first?

Hi ,

Thanks for reaching out. I’d probably start with a customer inquiry and follow-up process.

For example, when a customer sends an inquiry through a messaging channel or a form, n8n could capture the information, use an AI agent to understand the request, send an appropriate response, and log everything for follow-up. If needed, a RAG system could also provide answers based on the company’s documents or knowledge base.

I think this would be a practical starting point because it connects messaging, AI, APIs/webhooks, and data logging in one workflow.

I’d also be interested in hearing what type of business processes you’re currently working on and whether there’s an opportunity to collaborate.

Best,
Akash

Thanks, Matt. I really appreciate that. I’m also interested in working on practical business automations where n8n, AI agents, APIs/webhooks, and RAG can work together.

I’d be happy to collaborate on a project and contribute wherever my skills fit.

Hi Sumaya, thanks for reaching out! Your work sounds very relevant to what I’m currently working on, especially the n8n, API integration, and RAG side.

I’d definitely be interested in connecting and collaborating if a suitable project comes up. Having another person to work with on larger automation projects could be really helpful.

I’ll check out your GitHub as well. Great to connect!
